messages:
sam: Vendor asked if we can coordinate a single announcement for H100/H200 + MI300 + Gaudi. Theyre pushing for a one-day press window but admit Gaudi certification is lagging. Thoughts on risk and messaging?
ops-bot: Uploaded vendor health snapshot: https://vendor.example.com/health-2965432100 (driver status, cert ETA).
leo: Platform note: we can gate marketplace SKUs by image tag states. Recommend we prepare two public SKU states: FULL-GA and LIMITED-PREVIEW.
nina: For comms, avoid hard ship dates. Suggest: "Available in limited regions at launch; wider availability to follow." Keeps us flexible if Gaudi slips.
carol: SI partners need an EAP path for Gaudi so customers who need it can onboard early without confusing marketplace users. We should have an EAP checklist.
vendor-eng: Reality check: H100/H200/MI300 image tags done by Wed. Gaudi driver QA may slip 48h. We can provide a manifest with recommended fallbacks.
sam: Good. We want a single coordinated embargo internally but allow phased marketplace visibility. That means internal handshake must be strict.
leo: Routing policy idea: customers requesting "gaudi" get routed to "mi300-quant" automatically if Gaudi pool unavailable. We can encode this in a simple JSON manifest consumers will read. Example manifest snippet we can publish internally:
```
"fallbacks": {
  "gaudi": ["mi300-quant", "h200-quant"],
  "h200": ["h100-quant"]
}
```
carol: We'll use that for SI deploy playbooks and note which fallbacks alter perf/latency. Also add a note about model tokenization differences.
press: PR ask: can we coordinate a joint tech blog and a shorter customer-facing announcement? If Gaudi is limited, we'll call out partner EAP.
nina: Yes, plan: Day 0 high-level joint announcement + Day 7 technical deep-dive and SKU timeline update. Legal needs embargo copy that allows "coming soon" SKU mentions.
leo: Action items: 1) vendor-eng supply final image tags + fallback manifest by Wed COB; 2) carol publish EAP checklist and SI playbook; 3) nina draft public messaging and embargo text; 4) sam coordinate internal embargo handshake; 5) ops spin canary to run smoke suite (chat, summarization, embeddings) on quantized variants once tags live.
vendor-eng: Noted. Risk: Gaudi driver could slip an additional 24-48h. We'll update the manifest immediately if that happens.
sam: If Gaudi slips, we'll still proceed with joint announcement but mark Gaudi as "limited preview" and call out EAP. That preserves momentum.
carol: I'll draft the EAP onboarding doc and list SLA caveats.
leo: I'll prepare routing policy scripts and a small test harness for the fallback logic.
ops-bot: Canary cluster request created: CL-7890. Status: pending image tags.
nina: I'll share messaging drafts in /docs/partners/announce-drafts and loop in legal + comms.
sam: Great work. We'll reconvene Thu morning to confirm tags and go/no-go. Drop vendor PM updates here.
